description: - Assignment: Iteratively assign tasks ordered by descending regret (best minus
second-best profit gap), updating remaining capacities.
- Refinement: If upper bound is unmet, evaluate alternative scoring functions (resource
consumption, profit ratio, remaining capacity); retain superior feasible solution.
- Bounds: Supports up to 50 resources and 500 tasks.
Python accepts positive integer inputs within safe 32-bit arithmetic, preserves its inputs, uses zero-based resource indices, and returns value 0 when no feasible solution was found.
